name: ADS8689
description: Driver for the TI ADS868x family (ADS8681/ADS8685/ADS8689) 16-bit SAR ADC over SPI with a plain-GPIO CONVST/CS. The transport is injected; the register map, 32-bit command framing and transfer function are Arduino-free and host tested. Public headers live one level up in src/ and are reached through the project-wide -Isrc flag. Board-specific scaling deliberately lives in the consuming firmware, not here.
keywords: adc, ads8689, ads8681, ads8685, sar, spi
